answer: The protocol validates 1,000 distinct service slots by demanding capacity-reservations, requiring each agent to secure a unique timber-framed server slice to prove physical occupancy. A verifier probes these zones across a sprawling meadow of latency tests, where any detected relay triggers a rejection based on the fable of shared speed.
